attributes.description: Self-Hosted: per collection source (ciamSourceRef https://<host>/<folder path>): GET /vedsdk/certificates/ pages (ParentDnRecursive, Limit 500, OptionalFields Issuer,Subject), then per certificate GET details, PreviousVersions (earlier versions as own entries, ciamRenewedAs) and ValidationResults (SslTls host:port -> ciamInstalledAt; 204 = not validated) within one shared DETAIL_CALLS budget; the importer maps X509/CertificateDetails, ManagementType, Disabled, CreatedBy, Contact, Consumers, CertificateAuthorityDN, ProcessingDetails and RevocationStatus to ciamManagedCertificate facts. SaaS: POST /outagedetection/v1/certificatesearch (paging from 0, pageSize 50, up to the page past the count), api-key (tppl-api-key) or bearer; certificates mapped (SHA-1 fingerprint, serial, DNs, validity, names, status, origin, instances not SUPERSEDED), versionType OLD renewed as the CURRENT one of its managedCertificateId. No public-certificate retrieval.
attributes.external_dependencies: ["CyberArk Certificate Manager - Self-Hosted (Venafi TPP) Web SDK: GET /vedsdk/certificates/, /certificates/{guid}, /{guid}/PreviousVersions, /{guid}/ValidationResults (OAuth scope certificate; View + Read)", "CyberArk Certificate Manager - SaaS (Venafi TLS Protect Cloud) API: POST /outagedetection/v1/certificatesearch (tppl-api-key or service-account bearer; Guest read-only role)", "curl and jq (scripts/export-venafi.sh only)"]
attributes.purpose: CyberArk Certificate Manager (Venafi) read into the core pki domain as a certificate manager's inventory (never an issuance record), metadata only: Self-Hosted (TPP) policy folders (importer venafi/certificates, GET-only collector with a pre-issued bearer token, export script) and SaaS tenants (importer venafi/saas, collector whose only POST is the declared read-only certificate search)

attributes.name: in_service
attributes.purpose: Whether a managed certificate is in service on as_of: current, not revoked, management not disabled, and not an earlier version its manager says was replaced (ciamRenewedAs)

attributes.name: renewal_of
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "cert", "type": "Entry", "required": true}, {"name": "found", "type": "Entry|None", "required": true}, {"name": "rows", "type": "tuple of Entry", "required": true, "description": "managed certificates no record certificate matches"}, {"name": "as_of", "type": "date", "required": true}]
attributes.purpose: What the manager renewed a record certificate as, among rows no record certificate matches, or None: exact when the one found is an earlier version linked by ciamRenewedAs (the named certificate, if in service; never inferred then), else inferred: the latest in service for the same subject issued after it

attributes.name: managed_rows
attributes.purpose: managed-certificates report rows: each record certificate (its state; the managed certificate found, else (none found, or an earlier version found) the one it was renewed as; management, contacts, installations, renewal owner, detail), then each unrecorded in-service managed certificate

attributes.name: certificate_facts
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "listed", "type": null, "required": true}, {"name": "detail", "type": null, "required": true}, {"name": "validation", "type": null, "required": false, "default": "None"}]
attributes.purpose: (managed certificate facts of one listed Self-Hosted certificate, its details (None: not read) and its validation results (None: not read), notices): ciamManagedCertificate attributes, details winning over the listing; ciamInstalledAt = Consumers then validation host:port

attributes.name: read_source
attributes.purpose: (Imported group, notices) of one Self-Hosted collection source: its inventory and the certificates it holds plus their earlier versions (history); incomplete when listing, details, history or validation results fall short; denied when the listing was refused

attributes.name: certificate_steps
attributes.purpose: Collector steps per readable Self-Hosted source folder: first listing page, the pages its total says, then certificate_reads (details, PreviousVersions, ValidationResults within the shared DETAIL_CALLS budget); GETs only

attributes.name: renewed_as
attributes.purpose: The managed certificate among rows that an earlier version found names as what replaced it (ciamRenewedAs: its cn in the same inventory), or None; any manager

attributes.name: history_path
attributes.purpose: Where a source's certificate history (PreviousVersions) is kept in the export: venafi/<source>/history/<guid>.json

attributes.name: validation_path
attributes.purpose: Where a source's certificate validation results are kept in the export: venafi/<source>/validation/<guid>.json

attributes.name: installed_at
attributes.purpose: The host:port (IP when no host) Self-Hosted network validation found a certificate at, from its ValidationResults SslTls

attributes.name: version_key
attributes.purpose: The cn of an earlier version of a certificate: <guid>-v<VaultId>, else its thumbprint's hex; None when neither

attributes.name: earlier_versions
attributes.purpose: ((cn, facts), ...) of a certificate's earlier versions from its PreviousVersions history, each renewed as the certificate (ciamRenewedAs); the version with the listed certificate's own thumbprint left out

attributes.name: kept_history
attributes.purpose: Request keep function: PreviousVersions reduced to VaultId and CertificateDetails' VERSION_FIELDS; other text kept

attributes.name: kept_validation
attributes.purpose: Request keep function: ValidationResults reduced to SslTls Host/IpAddress/Port; empty body (HTTP 204) as {SslTls: [], Validated: false}

attributes.name: certificate_reads
attributes.purpose: ((path, Request), ...): details of each listed certificate (up to DETAIL_CALLS), then PreviousVersions and ValidationResults of as many as the shared budget leaves, in listing order

attributes.name: page_path
attributes.purpose: Where a SaaS source's certificate search page number (from 0) is kept: venafi-saas/<source>/search-<n>.json

attributes.name: sources
attributes.purpose: The SaaS collection sources an export holds (each with a search page), in order

attributes.name: search_pages
attributes.purpose: ((page number, document or None), ...) of a SaaS source's search pages, by number

attributes.name: cert_key
attributes.purpose: A SaaS certificate id as the record names it: lowercase

attributes.name: installed_at
attributes.purpose: Where the SaaS search says a certificate is installed: each instance not SUPERSEDED as hostname:port (IP when no host)

attributes.name: current_versions
attributes.purpose: {managedCertificateId: id of its CURRENT version} among the SaaS certificates found

attributes.name: saas_facts
attributes.purpose: The ciamManagedCertificate facts of one SaaS search certificate: SHA-1 fingerprint, serial, subject, issuer, validity, names, status, origin, installations, and for a versionType OLD its CURRENT version (ciamRenewedAs)

attributes.name: search_problems
attributes.purpose: Why a SaaS source's search pages don't hold every certificate: unreadable pages, pages missing up to one past the count, fewer found than the count, or the page past the count not empty

attributes.name: read_source
attributes.purpose: (Imported group, notices) of one SaaS collection source: its inventory (complete/incomplete/denied) and certificates

attributes.name: read_saas
attributes.purpose: Importer venafi/saas: per collection source in the export, its certificate manager inventory, replacing the record's

attributes.name: trimmed
attributes.purpose: A SaaS search certificate reduced to CERT_FIELDS, its SANs to dNSName/iPAddress and its instances to INSTANCE_FIELDS

attributes.name: kept_page
attributes.purpose: Request keep function factory: a SaaS search page reduced to count and trimmed certificates, with Address and PageSize

attributes.name: address_of
attributes.purpose: The SaaS API address a source location names (https://<host>[:port], no path), or None

attributes.name: search_body
attributes.purpose: The JSON text of the certificate search for page number (from 0), PAGE_SIZE per page

attributes.name: credential_of
attributes.purpose: How a SaaS source's credential is sent: ('api-key', ref, None, 'tppl-api-key') or ('bearer', ref, None)

attributes.name: saas_steps
attributes.purpose: Collector steps: each readable SaaS source's first search page, then every page up to one past the end its count says (read-only POSTs)

attributes.name: saas_source_problems
attributes.purpose: Why SaaS collection sources can't be read: scheme/credential problems, or a location that isn't an API address
